chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Rifa'ah ibn Musa al-Nakhhas, who said:

I asked Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him). I said: 'I buy a slave girl, and she stays with me for months without menstruating, and that is not due to old age. I show her to the women, and they tell me, 'She is not pregnant.' So is it permissible for me to have intercourse with her in her private part?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Menstruation can be withheld by the wind (or windiness) without pregnancy, so there is no problem if you touch her in the private part.' I said: 'But if she is pregnant, what is for me from her?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'If you intend so, in what is besides the private part.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on having intercourse with a non-menstruating slave girl if she is pregnant?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Musa al-Kazim (AS) addresses the fiqh of 'hayd ma'rufah' (regular menstruation) where a slave girl fails to menstruate due to a medical condition rather than age or pregnancy. He permits vaginal intercourse if pregnancy is ruled out by female examination, but advises non-vaginal intimacy if she is pregnant, reflecting the practical legal reasoning of the Imams regarding bodily purity and marital rights in the context of slavery.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Rafa’at Bin Musa Al Nakhhas who said,

‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan Musaasws Bin Ja’farasws saying, ‘I bought the slave girl, and she remained with me for months not menstruating, and that was not due to old age, and I showed her to the woman, so they said to me, ‘There is no pregnancy with her. So is it for me that I copulate with her in her private part?’ So heasws said: ‘The wind could have withheld the menstruation (Haydh) from without a pregnancy, so there is no problem if you touch her in the private part’. I said, ‘Supposing if there was a pregnancy with her, so what would be for me, from her?’ Heasws said: ‘If you intend so, in what is besides the private part’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from Rifa‘ah ibn Musa al-Nakhkhas who has said the following:

“I once asked Musa ibn Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a slave-girl I purchased. She lives with me for several months without experiencing Hayd (menses) but not because of old age. Other women examine her and tell me that she is not pregnant. Can I have intercourse with her? He (the Imam) said, ‘Hayd (menses) is sometimes blocked by air without pregnancy. It is not harmful if you touch her vagina? I then asked if she is pregnant what then? He (the Imam) said, ‘If you like you can benefit from other than vagina?”
